doc: A modal is a secondary window that communicates or provides an action inside the same process. They’re incredibly useful for communicating additional information, collecting information, or directing users without forcing them to leave the page. When modals are used unnecessarily, they can become intrusive and annoying for the user. Nobody likes pop-ups.
